content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The traditional platforms often fail creators in regions like Kenya due to restrictive policies and payment processing issues. COREMERCH provides a solution that relies on blockchain technology and decentralized infrastructure, ensuring that you retain full ownership and control of your digital products. By utilizing platforms like Cloudflare for hosting and NOWPayments for crypto transactions, you eliminate reliance on third-party services that may impose limitations or fees. This architecture not only empowers you to sell directly to your audience but also guarantees that your payment processing is secure, efficient, and cost-effective.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before setting up your digital store, you need a few essential tools and accounts. First, create a GitHub or Cloudflare account for hosting your site. Next, set up a NOWPayments account to handle cryptocurrency payments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies. You’ll also need a file storage solution for product delivery; consider Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Additionally, ensure you have a cryptocurrency wallet to manage your funds and connect to Binance P2P for conversion to local currencies like Kenyan shillings or naira. Finally, gather your digital products such as ebooks to upload once your infrastructure is in place.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Once your tools are ready, start by deploying your GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting. Next, integrate NOWPayments to process transactions. This step involves setting up API keys and configuring webhook notifications to handle payment confirmations automatically. For product delivery, use Google Sheets or Supabase to manage orders and track sales. When a payment is confirmed, your backend logic should trigger the delivery of the ebook directly to the customer’s email or a downloadable link. This seamless pipeline ensures that you can sell your products without manual intervention, providing a smooth experience for your customers.
Blockchain payments eliminate the reliance on traditional platforms.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

After setting up your infrastructure, it’s time to go live. Promote your ebook via social media and other channels to attract customers. When someone makes a purchase, they can pay using a cryptocurrency of their choice, and the transaction will settle in under 60 seconds for a nominal fee under $0.10, particularly if they use USDT on the Tron network. Once the payment is confirmed, your automated delivery system will fulfill the order, ensuring that the customer receives their ebook instantly. Monitor the process closely to address any issues that may arise during your first transactions.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your ecommerce infrastructure in place and running smoothly, it's time to think about scaling. Begin by analyzing your sales data and customer feedback to identify popular products or potential new offerings. You can expand your digital catalog by adding more ebooks or related digital products. Consider leveraging the Complete Builder Kit ($197) from COREMERCH, which includes all blueprints and templates you need to enhance your store's functionality and appearance. As your sales grow, ensure that your backend can handle increased traffic and transactions without compromising speed or security.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

The most practical path for creators in restricted countries starts with NOWPayments configured to receive USDT on Tron as the primary payment coin. USDT is a stable coin pegged to the US dollar — your revenue does not fluctuate with crypto market movements. Tron network fees are under $0.10, and settlement takes under 60 seconds. Once USDT arrives in your wallet, you convert to local currency through P2P exchanges — Binance P2P is available in most countries and supports naira, cedis, Kenyan shillings, and Pakistani rupees. The conversion takes 20 to 30 minutes on average and costs 2 to 5 percent.
You retain complete ownership of your digital products and customer data.

Creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe, and other restricted markets searching for international payment solutions are looking for the same thing: a way to receive USD-equivalent payments from global buyers without a Stripe or PayPal account. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete answer — Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments deployed under your accounts in 48 hours. For creators who want to self-deploy, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 covers both stack options with full source code and step-by-step configuration guides. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Create accounts on GitHub or Cloudflare for hosting your store. Set up a NOWPayments account to manage cryptocurrency transactions. Choose a file delivery solution like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Prepare your digital products, such as ebooks, for upload. Configure your backend logic to automate payment processing and product delivery. Launch your site and promote your ebooks to attract customers.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I accept payments without Stripe?
You can use NOWPayments to accept cryptocurrency payments directly on your site. This service allows you to process transactions without relying on traditional payment processors like Stripe.
What cryptocurrencies can I use for transactions?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including popular options like Bitcoin, Ethereum, and USDT. This variety enables customers to pay using their preferred digital currency.
How do I ensure product delivery after payment?

Set up automated delivery through your backend logic. Once a payment is confirmed, a webhook from NOWPayments will trigger the delivery of the product, ensuring customers receive their ebooks instantly.
Can I sell to international customers from Kenya?
Yes, by using NOWPayments and a decentralized infrastructure, you can sell digital products to anyone globally, bypassing restrictions imposed by traditional payment platforms.
What if I have issues during the setup?
COREMERCH offers support for 30 days after deployment. You can reach out for assistance to ensure your infrastructure is set up correctly and running efficiently.
